name: Florida State University

sources.label: FSU Registrar — Transcript Explanation (grading system and quality points)

scaleNotes: FSU has no A+ for undergraduates. The top grade is an A, worth 4.0 points.
Plus and minus grades move the value up or down by 0.25 points, not the 0.3 or 0.33 used at many schools.
IE (incomplete expired) and GE (no grade expired) count as 0 points in your GPA, like an F.

honors.rule: FSU calls Latin honors 'degrees of distinction.' Your FSU-only GPA and your combined GPA (FSU plus transfer and dual enrollment work) must both reach the cutoff. All college-level work you attempted counts, but remedial and vocational hours do not. You need at least 40 semester hours of letter-graded work at FSU. The honor read at graduation uses grades through the term before, and your final grades can change it.

schools.name: All undergraduates
extraRequirements: Both the FSU GPA and the combined GPA must meet the cutoff.
At least 40 semester hours of letter-graded work at FSU, including the final term.
